applicability: Joint recovery metrics apply to accounts only. The baseline rows in trials.json contain null joint fields. summary.json sums these to zero; those baseline zeros mean NOT EVALUATED, not failed recovery.
ordinary_origin: Ordinary retrieval scores use constructed source provenance; they are not human identity judgments. An absent-origin false acceptance does not establish perceptual dissimilarity.
recovery: Strict correspondence recovery checks the programmed event mapping. Substitution versus deletion-plus-insertion can fit the same sound; hidden construction history is not uniquely audible.
observation: Weak/masked/merged cases have separate observation metrics; strict full physical recovery is impossible when the corresponding event is undetected. Masked rejections are not counted as successful uncertainty-aware memory retrieval.
replication: 576 primary queries are clustered in 16 held-out groups. Ambiguity has 16 unique cases evaluated in two memory orders; 32 decisions are not 32 independent cases.
diagnostics: Top-rank and known-reference ceilings are post-hoc analyses of frozen outputs, not acceptance results or new tuned models.
